content:
Imports a scan that was previously exported in JSON format.
Note: Attachments and scan files in DB format can't be imported.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the WAS.SCAN_WAS.IMPORT  custom role privilege. Additionally,
requires the Can View [16] scan permission. See Roles and Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
multipart/form-data
required
string <binary>
The scan import JSON file to upload.
